quranTranslation.text: It is made lawful for you to go in unto your wives on the night of the fast. They are raiment for you and ye are raiment for them. Allah is Aware that ye were deceiving yourselves in this respect and He hath turned in mercy toward you and relieved you. So hold intercourse with them and seek that which Allah hath ordained for you, and eat and drink until the white thread becometh distinct to you from the black thread of the dawn. Then strictly observe the fast till nightfall and touch them not, but be at your devotions in the mosques. These are the limits imposed by Allah, so approach them not. Thus Allah expoundeth His revelation to mankind that they may ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „…dok vam se bijela nit ne razluči od crne niti – od zore (الْفَجْرِ)“ – zora kao granica posta.
explanation.en: “…until the white thread becometh distinct to you from the black thread of the dawn” — dawn as the limit of the fast.

quranTranslation.text: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

explanation.bs: „Mir je ona, sve do pojave zore (مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ)“ – kraj Noći Kadr.
explanation.en: “(The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn” — the end of the Night of Decree.

quranTranslation.text: Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.

explanation.bs: „…i učenje Kur'ana u zoru – zaista, učenje Kur'ana u zoru je posvjedočeno“ – učenje na sabahskom namazu.
explanation.en: “…and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed” — the recitation of the dawn prayer.

quranTranslation.text: And the breath of morning

explanation.bs: „I jutra kad zadiše!“ – jutro koje oživljava.
explanation.en: “And the breath of morning” — morning coming to life.

quranTranslation.text: And the dawn when it shineth forth,

explanation.bs: „I jutra kad se rasvijetli!“ – jutro koje se razvidjelo.
explanation.en: “And the dawn when it shineth forth” — morning grown light.

quranTranslation.text: (The messengers) said: O Lot! Lo! we are messengers of thy Lord; they shall not reach thee. So travel with thy people in a part of the night, and let not one of you turn round - (all) save thy wife. Lo! that which smiteth them will smite her (also). Lo! their tryst is (for) the morning. Is not the morning nigh?

explanation.bs: „Zaista, njihov rok je jutro. Zar jutro nije blizu?“ – jutro kao čas kazne Lutovog naroda.
explanation.en: “Lo! their tryst is (for) the morning. Is not the morning nigh?” — morning as the hour of Lot's people's punishment.

quranTranslation.text: By the morning hours

explanation.bs: „Tako mi prijepodneva (وَالضُّحَى)!“ – zakletva prijepodnevnom svjetlošću.
explanation.en: “By the morning hours” — an oath by the forenoon light.

quranTranslation.text: By the sun and his brightness,

explanation.bs: „Tako mi Sunca i njegova sjaja (وَضُحَاهَا)!“ – ضُحًى kao sjaj Sunca.
explanation.en: “By the sun and his brightness” — ضُحًى as the sun's radiance.

quranTranslation.text: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.

explanation.bs: Musa traži da se ljudi skupe „kad se sunce podigne (ضُحًى)“ – tefsir: vrijeme kad svi mogu vidjeti.
explanation.en: Moses asks that the people be gathered “when the sun hath risen high” — tafsir: the time when all can see.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of night and day, and the ships which run upon the sea with that which is of use to men, and the water which Allah sendeth down from the sky, thereby reviving the earth after its death, and dispersing all kinds of beasts therein, and (in) the ordinance of the winds, and the clouds obedient between heaven and earth: are signs (of Allah's Sovereignty) for people who have sense.

explanation.bs: „…i u lađama (فُلْك) što morem plove noseći ono od čega ljudi imaju koristi“ – mnoge lađe; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “…and the ships (فُلْك) which run upon the sea with that which is of use to men” — many ships; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Build the ship under Our eyes and by Our inspiration, and speak not unto Me on behalf of those who do wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.

explanation.bs: Nuhu je rečeno: „Gradi lađu (فُلْك) pred Našim očima i prema Našem nadahnuću“ – jedna lađa.
explanation.en: Noah is told: “Build the ship (فُلْك) under Our eyes and by Our inspiration” — one ship.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who maketh you to go on the land and the sea till, when ye are in the ships and they sail with them with a fair breeze and they are glad therein, a storm-wind reacheth them and the wave cometh unto them from every side and they deem that they are overwhelmed therein; (then) they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only: If Thou deliver us from this, we truly will be of the thankful.

explanation.bs: „…kad ste na lađama (فُلْك), pa one s njima plove nošene blagim vjetrom…“ – plovidba ljudi.
explanation.en: “… when ye are in the ships (فُلْك) and they sail with them with a fair breeze…” — people's sailing.

quranTranslation.text: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.

explanation.bs: „A brod (سَفِينَة) – bio je vlasništvo nekih siromaha koji su na moru radili“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “As for the ship (سَفِينَة), it belonged to poor people working on the river” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.

explanation.bs: „I njih dvojica krenuše, pa kad su se ukrcali u brod (سَفِينَة), on ga je probušio.“
explanation.en: “So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship (سَفِينَة), he made a hole therein.”

quranTranslation.text: And We rescued him and those with him in the ship, and made of it a portent for the peoples.

explanation.bs: „Pa smo izbavili njega [Nuha] i ljude u brodu (سَفِينَة), i učinili smo ga znakom za svjetove.“
explanation.en: “And We rescued him [Noah] and those with him in the ship (سَفِينَة), and made of it a portent for the peoples.”

quranTranslation.text: Those who believe and obscure not their belief by wrongdoing, theirs is safety; and they are rightly guided.

explanation.bs: „Oni koji vjeruju i svoje vjerovanje ne miješaju s nepravdom – njima pripada sigurnost, i oni su upućeni“ – sigurnost kao nagrada vjerovanja; Poslanik je ovu ‚nepravdu‘ objasnio kao širk, pripisivanje ortaka Allahu (Buhari, Muslim).
explanation.en: “Those who believe and obscure not their belief by wrongdoing, theirs is safety; and they are rightly guided” — security as the reward of faith; the Prophet explained this ‘wrongdoing’ as shirk, associating others with Allah (Bukhari, Muslim).

quranTranslation.text: And if any tidings, whether of safety or fear, come unto them, they noise it abroad, whereas if they had referred it to the messenger and to such of them as are in authority, those among them who are able to think out the matter would have known it. If it had not been for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy ye would have followed Satan, save a few (of you).

explanation.bs: „A kad im dođe kakva vijest o sigurnosti ili o strahu, oni je razglase …“ – sigurnost kao suprotnost strahu.
explanation.en: “And if any tidings, whether of safety or fear, come unto them, they noise it abroad” — security set against fear.

quranTranslation.text: And when We made the House (at Makka) a resort for mankind and sanctuary, (saying): Take as your place of worship the place where Abraham stood (to pray). And We imposed a duty upon Abraham and Ishmael, (saying): Purify My house for those who go around and those who meditate therein and those who bow down and prostrate themselves (in worship).

explanation.bs: „I kad smo Kuću učinili mjestom kojem se ljudi vraćaju i sigurnim mjestom …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And when We made the House (at Makka) a resort for mankind and sanctuary” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,

explanation.bs: „Rekli smo: ‚O vatro, budi hladnoća i mir Ibrahimu!‘“ – mir kao pošteđenost od štete.
explanation.en: “We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham” — peace as being spared harm.

quranTranslation.text: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

explanation.bs: „… ‚Lijepo strpljenje!‘ …“ – Jakubove riječi kad su mu donijeli Jusufovu košulju; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “(My course is) comely patience” — Jacob's words when they brought him Joseph's shirt; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.

explanation.bs: „… pa lijepo praštaj“ – ljepota u načinu na koji se prašta.
explanation.en: “So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness” — beauty in the way one forgives.

quranTranslation.text: Who is it that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, so that He may give it increase manifold? Allah straiteneth and enlargeth. Unto Him ye will return.

explanation.bs: „Ko je taj koji će Allahu dati dobar zajam, pa da mu ga On višestruko uveća …“ – dobro po uvidu, ne po izgledu.
explanation.en: “Who is it that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, so that He may give it increase manifold?” — good to insight, not to the eye.

quranTranslation.text: And her Lord accepted her with full acceptance and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth; and made Zachariah her guardian. Whenever Zachariah went into the sanctuary where she was, he found that she had food. He said: O Mary! Whence cometh unto thee this (food)? She answered: It is from Allah. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.

explanation.bs: „Pa ju je Gospodar njen primio dobrim prijemom i dao joj da dobro uzraste …“ – o Merjemi; dobro i u prihvatanju i u rastu.
explanation.en: “And her Lord … vouchsafed to her a goodly growth” — of Mary; good both in being accepted and in growing up.
